title: Travel forward RIGHT PPC pressure sensor malfunction
detail_of_failure: The signal voltage of the travel forward right PPC pressure sensor circuit becomes 0.3 V or below or 4.5 V or above.
controller_action: • Controls the machine by regarding the travel forward right PPC pressure sensor as 0 MPa. • If the cause of the failure disappears, the machine becomes normal by itself.
machine_effect: • The auto-deceleration function cannot be canceled. • Degraded operability of travel.
related_information: Notice If the connection of the 5 V circuit (3) and ground circuit (1) of the pressure sensor are inverted, the pressure sensor will break. Take extreme care when checking. Pre-troubleshooting If failure code [DA25KP] is also shown, do the troubleshooting for this code first. Monitoring code The Travel Forward Right PPC pressure can be monitored. (Code: 07103)

steps.procedure: 1. Check the wiring harnesses and connectors. REMARK For details of checking method, see “RELATED INFORMATION TO TROUBLESHOOT”, “CHECKS BEFORE TROUBLESHOOTING”, “Electrical equipment”. 2. Are the wiring harnesses and connectors normal?

branches.YES: • The wiring harnesses and connectors are normal. • Go to the next inspection item.
branches.NO: • A wiring harness or connector is defective. • Repair or replace the defective wiring harness or connector. • Go to “Confirmation of repair”.
